title: tax-terminal
description: RFC 0053 / format 4.9. The next buyer's tax after this sale reassesses at the exit price. TAX-08 ties the basis to exit_value_gross.

jurisdiction.description: A label. No jurisdiction rules are inferred from it.

value_basis.description: The value the ratio applies to. Stated together with assessment_ratio or not at all.

indicated_tax.description: What the inputs above produce, before any rounding.

round_to_decimals.description: Protocol VIII.5 decimals. May be negative to round to a magnitude. Absent means the currency quantum.

in_exit_noi.description: Whether this tax is already inside the stated exit_noi.

value_basis_differs_because.description: Required when a sale-triggered basis is not exit_value_gross (TAX-08).
